notes.title: 9/15/2024 Patch Notes and Merch Drop
notes.content:
First off- [url=https://www.etsy.com/shop/FanNiche?section_id=39061915]Merch is here! If you missed your chance to support development during the EF2 Kickstarter and you’ve already picked up the Beloved Ghost DLC, this is another great option. There are still some extras of the physical rewards from Kickstarter- Keychains, standees, pins, and plushies- but more pressingly, there’s new apparel![/url]

Until now, the only Entropic Float apparel available was through Print-On-Demand. Redbubble and TeePublic can be very useful tools, but the print quality to cost ratio isn’t always the best, and this new collection has more than simple logo tees. You’ll be able to pick up…

[b]Entropic Float Logo T-Shirt[/b], available as a polyester-spandex blend comfort tee or cotton tee. This design simply features the logo on a black shirt, with a purple collar and sleeves in the comfort tee version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464787/3a539261c2bef7aacf3f0878045467a7aa48a1a2.jpg[/img]

[b]Renfield Future Tour Comfort Tee[/b], based on the fictional band appearing in Beloved Ghost and the upcoming Entropic Float 2. A light blue shirt with black sleeves, featuring the band’s logo on the front and an assortment of Entropic Float related tour locations on the back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464787/db27f4215af254a03a679935b5e3d7d0bff202d3.jpg[/img]

[b]Shrimps Is Bugs Comfort Tee[/b], the very same design that Touko Nozomi wears during The Tale Of The Secret Knowledge in the DLC. A gray shirt with pink sleeves and a cute shrimp graphic!

[b]Kanatsun Pajama Pants[/b]- Black pants with large purple stars! Also a polyester-spandex blend. Wear at home for comfort. Wear out of the house to… Be judged for your fashion sense just like Kanatsun, probably. Has pockets and a drawstring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464787/9d535514ae40790d30bb5b86b4816dcf421abbc6.jpg[/img]

Some fun stuff! Of course, I’m always open to suggestions for new items if there’s a specific piece of Entropic Float apparel your heart yearns for. The manufacturer I work with offers a lot of variety, so don’t be afraid to ask! I just get decision paralysis and end up designing for the same clothing types that I’ve had good experiences with before, rather than thinking of something to design for a new shape. I’d be happy to do so on your behalf!

[b]Now, on to the actual update log:[/b]
- Modified statement following the post-credits scene. The game now mentions the DLC, explaining how to access it if you already own it, and that you can purchase it if you don’t.
- Not an in-game change, but the steam page now properly directs to the DLC as well.
- Found and fixed a few more errors in the text.

[b]Beloved Ghost DLC Changes:[/b]
- Changed the colors of several name badges to improve legibility.
- Added a small number of additional responses to both ‘player conversation’ sections. [spoiler] You can now ask 'Are you okay' thanks to popular demand, and a few other little things to find. [/spoiler]
- Found and fixed a few more errors in the text here as well.

notes.title: Entropic Float 2 Kickstarter Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464787/d0407677207bee23da03a5278930621d5f79fc9c.png[/img]

[b]Steam version of the demo is still coming soon! Unfortunately, many things have happened in my personal life preventing me from sitting down with the time-consuming process that is getting a new steam page set up, approved, and configuring the uploader tool. In the meantime, here's news![/b]

Midway through the day on November 18th, we hit our funding goal of $2,000 USD! Thank you so much to everybody who contributed- Every single pledge and promo post has been so incredible, we never could have made it without the amazing response and support from the community! I never could have imagined that we'd make it to the finish line so quickly, and I cannot overstate my gratitude. In just one week, you came together to give us a proper budget, an amazing upgrade from the first game!

With this funding goal reached, Entropic Float 2: Land Of The Witch will be able to pay for the partial voice acting of 7 lines per character, all 20 memory-seeking CGs from Shoii, and a portion of its original soundtrack costs. The money raised will also, of course, go toward taxes, fees, and fulfillment of your wonderful rewards! Look forward to your goodies, which as stated on the main page, I hope to deliver by May!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nhitori/entropic-float-2-land-of-the-witch]Of course, hitting the finish line isn’t the end of the Kickstarter! [/url]Any additional funds raised will make the final game even better. An extra fifty can be another CG added, an extra hundred can be an additional title screen variation from Soyokaze (along with an additional acrylic standee!), but even just one more dollar can be put to use making sure that Entropic Float 2 and the Beloved Ghost DLC are the best they can be.

These remaining days are still plenty of time to push ahead towards our stretch goals, but first, how about a preview of what you’re supporting?

“The Tale Of The Secret Knowledge” by Guest Author Kinu Nishimura II

[i]One year after the events in the Clock Tower, the McGermanottas arrive for a summer trip in the town of Mesteri, Washington, to visit the Nozomis. Despite the dreary, hopeless nature of the town, a new mystery unfolds before Stephanie's eyes—but is it a mystery that will allow her to win the battle against herself?
 
A tale of 'the bonds of family' unfolds in the world of Entropic Float! Though, that's not to discount the burning-hot young love, either... Perhaps it's a bit long of a diversion from your goal of reuniting with 'her', but it's up to you to choose to continue.[/i]

More info on the Tale here: https://pastebin.com/kJJDTFbb 

That’s just one of the many side stories you’ll be able to find in the DLC- Which, I’ll reiterate, you get a key to download with any pledge above $5 USD! For Entropic Float 2 to be the best game it can be, it’s going to take some time, so I hope that the Letters To A Beloved Ghost will be a wonderful narrative snack in the world of Entropic Float before I can get you the main course.

Moving on to those stretch goals mentioned above!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464787/3a12980b6056ac014443f356112caa818d36d333.png[/img]

We’re well on our way to the first stretch of $2,500 ! At this goal, we’ll be able to produce an official cover of the full version of Midnight’s Requiem~

If we surpass this goal, the next in line is musical as well! At $3,000 USD, we’ll get the opportunity to make an actual Renfield Future song- The guy whose design you can vote on if you’ve pledged at least $15 is a musician after all! This song would be featured in both the DLC and EF2, so it’s a stretch goal everybody can appreciate. Help us show off his personality with his band’s hot single!

If we manage to pass that goal, $3,500 waits on the horizon! Reaching this goal allows us to commission several more title screens from the artist Soyokaze, adding versions with different characters and allowing those characters to be added as acrylic standees! In addition, reaching this goal will add a poll for backers to vote between a few options for a bonus side story to be included in the DLC- These would be stories featuring characters from the second game, as opposed to the current lineup that mainly features those from the first, a great way to get another taste of EF2’s characters prior to its release.

Finally, with one last big jump, $5,000 is a stretch goal that would let us add a substantial amount more voice acting! It would still be limited to key moments, but we’d get a few more voiced lines from each of our wonderful VAs to help the characters feel even more alive. And if this goal is reached, every option that would have been included on the poll will be added to the DLC!

notes.title: DLC Survey + 9/23 Update Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! The ‘August QoL Update’ is finally ready now, halfway through September. Long story short is that I kept thinking of ways to spruce up the game, so my list got longer instead of shorter. But it’s ready now! Changelog is below, but first…

I’d like to invite anybody who’s completed Entropic Float: This World Will Decay And Disappear to participate in an interest survey for the contents of a DLC! Entropic Float 2 is still just as planned as ever- The ‘Letters To A Beloved Ghost’ DLC will be a collection of side stories. Side stories about what, exactly? That’s where you come in!

There are already several planned stories with plot relevance- Connecting threads between Entropic Float and Entropic Float 2 that fit better in the DLC than in either game, for example. But I’m also interested in seeing what sort of stories you’d be looking for from a side story DLC.

That’s what this survey is for! Let your voice be heard if you’ve got your heart set on seeing more of a particular character. https://forms.gle/SFbzBhUvnuLZPL7D9

‘Letters To A Beloved Ghost’ is tentatively expected to release this time next year. The new content won’t be using any koikatsu assets, and so will be priced at 5 USD or free with any pledge to the EF2 Kickstarter. If you’re interested in being a guest writer of a side story, you’re welcome to reach out to me.

Without further ado, now, the changelog!

List first, then a detailed breakdown of those changes which can be broken down.

[b]Major Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Overhauled the Memory Seeking system
[*] Implemented two different ‘replay buttons’.
[/list]

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Text speed no longer resets each time the game is opened.
[*] On first startup, music volume setting should now be balanced against voice and sound effects.
[*] The ‘Are You Making Fun Of Me’ achievement has been moved to trigger upon name entry (in the name entry scene)
[*] Something now happens if you try to climb the tree in Amelie’s route enough times.
[*] The save menu now shows your current route at the top of the page.
[*] Modified character introductions on Amelie Morning and Amelie Noon.
[*] Modified lines on Kanatsun’s branch to better signal which timeslot you’ve ended up in.
[*] Modified Rashmi’s Exposition on Amelie’s branch.
[*] Modified some of Peri’s dialogue which created a plot hole.
[*] Rearranged the profiles page so the three protagonists now appear at the top.
[*] Changed wording on Malcolm’s profile page to remedy an accidental implication.
[*] Choices now appear purple if you’ve selected them before.
[*] Improved consistency of highlighting and capitalization of lore-related proper nouns.
[*] Found and fixed a number of typos and other minor mistakes.
[/list]

[b]Memory Seeking Overhaul:[/b]
[list]
[*] The first time you reach an ending, you’ll have the option to view your choice of memory early.
[*] Certain memories are excluded from this, or locked behind specific endings.
[*] Whatever number of memories you choose to view this way (Up to 18) will be skipped in the Miracle Route’s memory seeking segment.
[*] In order to view memories a second time, you will now need to choose ‘reset memory seeking’ at the start of a Miracle Route replay.
[*] Hopefully, the option of spreading out the memories will invite players to pick between pacing styles for character backstories; reading them gradually or all at once to preference.
[/list]

[b]Replay Buttons:[/b]
[list]
[*] After completing the game, you’ll gain access to two different replay options.
[*] A ‘full replay’ which resets all progress-related persistent data: Not ‘seen text’ or ‘selected choices’, but player gender, character notes, endings, and memories.
[*] A ‘memory reset’ which only resets persistent data related to memory seeking, allowing memories to be viewed a second time.
[*] Both of these options will appear after you’ve started the game post-completion.
[/list]

[b]Are You Making Fun Of Me:[/b]
[list]
[*] Achievement now triggers in a scene following use of the relevant name during the name entry scene.
[*] Dialogue variations exist for doing so with and without persistent data for completing the game.
[*] This refers only to the diagetic name entry- If you use a miracle route skip option and enter the name, it will not happen.
[/list]

[b]Climbing The Tree:[/b]
If you try to climb the tree more than ten times you will get a game over scene.

[b]Character Introductions:[/b]
[list]
[*] In the early scenes of Amelie’s morning and noon routes, the introductions have been modified.
[*] Previously, there were places where characters’ introductory voicelines went directly next to each other without any transitional dialogue between.
[*] This has been smoothed over with a few additional lines.
[*] Rashmi also no longer uses an introductory voice line as a floater, as neither of the others do.
[/list]

[b]Rashmi’s Exposition:[/b]
[list]
[*] Previously, Amelie’s branch was the only part of the game in which exposition could be skipped over.
[*] This was a holdover from early design, when I expected the details of each loop to have much more in common than ended up happening.
[*] The exposition is no longer skippable, and has distinct dialogue between morning and night as with the other routes.
[/list]

[b]Malcolm’s Wording:[/b]
[list]
[*] The wording of one of Malcolm’s notes when paired with its associated voiceline created an unintended implication.
[*] The wording has now been changed.
[/list]

[b]Highlighting and Capitalization:[/b]
[list]
[*] ‘Wish’ and ‘Entropy’ are more consistently capitalized and highlighted across the script.
[*] The word ‘wish’ is no longer erroneously capitalized and highlighted in places where it isn’t being used as a proper noun.
[/list]
